anomalies.observed: FCC1 VDD pins (11,27,50,75,100) and NAVC1 VDD pins (19,32,48,64) are listed as unconnected nets. NAVC1 VSS pins (18,63) are tied together on Net-(NAVC1-VSS-Pad18) and not connected to GND.
anomalies.expected: All MCU VDD pins should connect to the 3.3V rail (+3V3 or +3.3V), and VSS pins should connect to GND.
anomalies.impact: Both MCUs lack power and ground connections, so the board cannot boot or function.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 HSE crystal (HSE1) is connected to FCC1 pins 5 (PE6) and 37 (PE7) instead of the HSE pins PH0 (12) and PH1 (13). NAVC1 HSE crystal (HSE2) is connected to nets HSE_IN_NAVC and HSE_OUT_NAVC but these nets do not include NAVC1; NAVC1 PH0 (5) and PH1 (6) are instead on separate nets with only capacitors C37/C38.
anomalies.expected: HSE1 should connect to FCC1 PH0/PH1, and HSE2 should connect to NAVC1 PH0/PH1, as specified for the 25 MHz HSE crystals.
anomalies.impact: Neither MCU receives a clock from its external crystal, so they cannot run at the intended HSE frequency.

anomalies.observed: C25 is specified as 100u (100 µF) with footprint Capacitor_SMD:C_0402_1005Metric.
anomalies.expected: A 0402 capacitor cannot provide 100 µF; typical decoupling in this location is 100 nF. The value and footprint are inconsistent.
anomalies.impact: The specified part cannot be assembled; if a smaller value is substituted, decoupling may be inadequate.
